name: Aido-kan
source:
Nobusuke works in Akimiya family as a servant under the pseudonym of Kenji. It is for Kuon Misaka, who is the love of his life.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ054782.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
信辅以健二的化名，在秋宫家担任仆人。这一切都是为了他一生所爱的美坂久远。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ054782.html]DLsite English[/url]]
